snippet.title: Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition - Nintendo Switch Pre-Order trailer
snippet.description:
Now available for pre-orders!

🤝 The perfect family game to (re)discover maths, solo or coop 
🧩 A fun puzzle platformer in vibrant world harboring many secrets 
🧠 Designed to help improve logic and mathematical thinking 

Nintendo eShop Europe: 
Nintendo eShop Americas: https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/nero-and-sci-integral-edition-switch
Follow us on socials: https://linktr.ee/sourislab

In Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition, players explore a colorful world made up of numbers, shapes, and mathematical symbols, while solving puzzles through observation and experimentation. The game makes mathematical thinking intuitive and accessible, whether playing alone or with family, and appeals to both analytical and creative minds.
